purpose: Evaluate whether high-value decision questions have enough current, source-bound context to permit a candidate-only answer and identify the exact missing evidence when they do not.
invariants: A use case delegates status and strategic-evidence safety to the W14 decision-context projection.
Candidate answers always retain CANDIDATE_ONLY posture and source assertion lineage.
A missing, stale, future, or conflicting required observation cannot support a candidate answer.
Unreviewed or conflicted strategic evidence blocks the candidate answer and identifies HITL as the path forward.
A support-only claim may support a candidate answer only when its counterevidence gap is conspicuous.
A use case cannot expose an answer section not declared in its contract.
This evaluator does not call a provider, write graph state, make a recommendation final, or activate a release.

state_rules.candidate_answer_with_gaps: W14 returns CANDIDATE_WITH_GAPS; every gap is disclosed in the candidate answer contract.

required_cases: AI-PDLC POV candidate answer with counterevidence
AI productivity metric candidate answer with a visible evidence gap
missing project status blocks answer readiness

dependencies.w12_approved_migration: not required for this provider-free evaluator; required before target-graph writes
